balls.text: Natarajan goes for the wide yorker once again. Comes out as a low full-toss, which is sliced to the right of short third. Good diving save from that infielder
Mowed over wide long-on for six. Natarajan aims for the wide yorker. Comes out as a low full-toss. Dube loads up and smokes it over the leg side to thrill a capacity crowd
slower short ball outside off. Good bowling from Natarajan. Dhoni loses his shape as he heaves wide of midwicket

low full-toss on the pads, Natarajan just misses the yorker. Whipped in the air. Deep square leg (Abhishek) runs in to attack the ball but the ball bounces in front and rolls to the boundary. Chepauk is loving this
No century for Gaikwad. Well done, Natarajan. Caught at long-on. Another slowie from Natarajan, just outside off, Gaikwad can't manufacture enough power. Holes out to Reddy.
slower short ball, veering down the leg side, Natarajan gets away with it as Gaikwad can only deflect it as far as Klaasen behind the stumps
Unadkat goes for the wide yorker, marginally misses his length but Dube can only drill it straight to mid-off. Another excellent defensive over from Unadkat.
wide yorker, stabbed away through the covers

short, wide, Gaikwad slashes this slowie to point and hares across to the other end. A better throw, from Cummins I think, could've had Gaikwad. A wayward throw also makes the job difficult for Unadkat at the non-striker's end
slow, full, wide. Gaikwad reaches out for the ball and smears it away to deep cover
Unadkat rolls out another slower short ball, which is flapped away to long leg
slower short ball outside off, Dube swivels and hooks it over midwicket. But does not time it well enough to clear the boundary
slowie outside off, full and wide, 115.3ks, plinked over mid-off. Gaikwad comes back for the second
acceptable wide yorker from Cummins. Dube stays leg-side of it and drills it away to deep cover
Cummins keeps taking pace off and bowling wide lines. Hoicked away to deep midwicket
slower short ball wide of off. Dube swings for the hills but can't touch this. Klaasen can't collect the ball cleanly behind the stumps

Cummins goes for the yorker, but misses it by a small margin as well. Dube stays deep in the crease for this length, gets underneath the ball and shovels it powerfully between deep midwicket and wide long-on
Dube hangs back, another slower bouncer wide of off, but this has been deemed a wide
Dube has muscled this over Cummins' head. 119.6ks, slower ball into the pitch and wide of off. Dube somehow connects with it and pumps a straight six. He's the god of sixes alright at Chepauk
Natarajan ditches the yorker for the slower bouncer, another variation he has been working on this IPL. Dube swivels and helps the ball down to fine leg
goes for the yorker once again but slides it down the leg side
Natarajan misses the yorker by a small margin. Comes out a wide full-toss. Dube stays leg-side of the ball and smites it over the cover boundary. This is a cruel game for bowlers
wide yorker from Natarajan. Gaikwad shapes to sweep it away, gets the ball down to fine leg off the inside half
Natarajan nails another off-stump yorker, Dube can't get underneath it. He ekes out an inside-edge onto the pad. Natarajan dives forward from his followthrough but the ball bounces in front of him

slower bouncer from Natarajan. Offcutter into the pitch, beats Dube on the pull and drifts down the leg side. Dube reckons this is a leg-side wide and hence reviews it. Touch and go. Tight call. Tough call. Wide called. Poor Natarajan

Natarajan goes for another yorker, marginally misses it on off stump. Dube doesn't quite get underneath it. He miscues it and clears deep midwicket for another six. Chants of "Dube!Dube!Dube!" ring around Chepauk
oh boy! He's nailing his yorkers this season. Right at the base of middle, dug back to Natarajan
slower short ball into the body. Gaikwad swivels, holds his shape and pulls it away fine of Natarajan at long leg for four more
Cummins marginally misses the yorker outside off. Gaikwad is deep in the crease, waiting for it, he ends up deliberately carving it between point and short third
short, wide, Dube reaches out for the ball and slices it to the off-side sweeper
yorker at the legs, 140.3ks, squirted to midwicket
slowie into the deck, as Cummins as Gaikwad to manufacture enough pace for himself. The CSK capt backs away and swishes it over extra-cover
short and hides it away from the swinging arc of Dube. The batter doesn't move his feet and stabs it down to long-off
short at the body, Dube hangs back and pats it through the mid-on region
short, wide, cracked away to deep point
overpitched and on off, with mid-off up in the circle. Gaikwad clears his front leg and hoists it over that infielder for another boundary
this might have been a better ball to the man at the other end. But the striker is a pace-hitter. On-pace short ball, below the ribs, Gaikwad sizes it up and hooks it over square leg for six
on-pace short ball from Bhuvneshwar, he digs it into the deck and leaves Dube in a tangle. The ball thuds into the thigh pad and then rolls to the off side
Bhuvneshwar tries the yorker, comes out as a low full-toss, which is squirted through square leg
on a length and outside off, seems like another slowie from Unadkat, dragged down to long-on. Good defensive bowling from Unadkat once again
flipped into the stands beyond fine leg. 110ks slower short ball from Unadkat. Gaikwad was waiting for this. He shuffles across off and shovels it over short fine leg, who is up in the circle
Unadkat nails the yorker this time, squeezed down to long-on

Mitchell is disappointed after hitting a full-toss to deep midwicket. He throws his head back, but he has to go. He chats with the umpires and then walks back to the dugout. Unadkat aims for the yorker, comes out as a full-toss, but it's below the waist and messes with Mitchell's timing. Dragged to Reddy at deep midwicket
Gaikwad backs away before shuffling back into line once again to keep this off-stump yorker out. Squeezed to cover
Gaikwad backs away, Unadkat loses his line. Off-side wide as the slower ball goes wrong
Mitchell is standing deep in the crease for these yorker-length deliveries. Swiped away to long-on
slowie, short and outside off, 120.6ks, swatted down to long-on
punched down to long-off

slower short ball outside off, pulled away to deep midwicket. Mitchell pumps his fist and takes in the cheers from Chepauk. 29-ball half-century for Mitchell. He will be among the first names on the team sheet when NZ announce their T20 WC squad tomorrow
Mitchell is showing his range tonight. 117.5ks slowie outside off, he had shaped to scoop it over short fine leg, he changes his direction and then flips it over short third in the end
seems like a slot ball, full and into the pads, Mitchell nearly swings himself off his feet. Inside-edged onto the pad, I think
back of a length and outside off, slogged away along the ground to deep midwicket
tossed up and turns away wide of of, Mitchell reaches out for the ball and slices it off a thick outside edge over point

Shovelled away with the bottom wrist between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Mitchell had backed away, so Shahbaz follows him and fires one into his moving pads. Excellent save I think from Reddy, running across to his left from deep midwicket
now it's Gaikwad's turn to run down the pitch and secure a single down to long-off
Mitchell steps out of his crease and swipes a single to long-on
More of #Dazball at Chepauk. Pushed through flat and quick, Mitchell manufactures swinging room and pumps it over Shahbaz's head with a smooth swing of the bat
sliding down the leg side, Mitchell paddles it away fine of short fine leg for four more
After getting hit for a boundary, what does Natarajan do? Go for a yorker of course. This comes out as a full-toss, though, which is pushed down to long-off
slower bouncer outside off. Mitchell leaps off his feet, waits for the ball, and then ramps it over short third
Natarajan aims for another yorker, but he doesn't nail this, but it's still a hard-to-hit delivery. Whipped to deep midwicket
leg-stump yorker from Natarajan. You just can't get underneath it. Superb defensive bowling from Natarajan. Jammed down to long-on
very full and on the stumps, on-pace delivery, whipped away to deep midwicket
slower bouncer from wide of the crease. But it's too high and called a wide
hard-length delivery wide of off, stabbed away to extra-cover on the back foot
slower short ball wide of off, Gaikwad heaves it over midwicket off the inner half
swatted away to the right of deep midwicket. Reddy hauls the ball back into play. Hip-high slower short ball, Gaikwad pulls it away over the leg side
stabbed into the leg side for a single

pitched-up delivery outside off, possibly another slowie from Unadkat. Mitchell reads it and smashes it over the ducking umpire. He owns the V in front when he's in good touch. He's working himself back into the groove
another terrific slower short ball from Unadkat. Just a shade outside off, Gaikwad waits for the ball to arrive, then dinks it to short third
slower short ball, Unadkat drags it away from the swinging arc of Mitchell. Hauled away to the right of midwicket

smoked over midwicket! Gaikwad follows up his century with a half-century. Fifty off 27 balls. Chepauk is loving this from its captain. Shortish and outside off, not sure if this was the slower ball into the pitch, but it does not matter. Gaikwad puts it into the stands beyond midwicket
inswinging yorker, lands it right at the base of off stump, squirted down to long-on
shorter and outside off, on-pace delivery, Gaikwad uses the pace and forces the ball to sweeper cover
hard-length delivery, aimed at the top of off stump, hoicked down to long-on
another slower ball from Cummins, but this is shorter in length, nudged into the leg side

#Dazball at Chepauk. Daz Mitchell pumping the ball down the ground. Cummins puts it full and just outside off, Mitchell lines up this offcutter and launches it over long-off. First six for CSK in the ninth over
darted into off stump, good defensive bowling from Shahbaz, pushed down to long-off once again
pushed through just a shade outside off, punchily driven down to long-off on the front foot
Gaikwad finds the gap this time. Beats the infielder as well as the outfielder. Slapped away to the right of point and left of sweeper cover. Precise placement
Gaikwad makes room, slaps from the stumps and finds point
shorter and outside off, Gaikwad latches onto the width and cuts it wide of the off-side sweeper
down the track and driven to extra-cover
another slowie outside off, Mitchell delays his back-foot punch and finds short cover
back of a length and outside off, punched between point and cover
slower bouncer outside off. You will see a lot of this from SRH tonight. Gaikwad delays his hook and gets a double to deep square
good length and outside off, another slower cutter, stabbed to mid-off
thrashed away to the left of mid-off! Slowie outside off, Mitchell holds his shape for long enough once again and frees his arms
rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and secures a single to deep third
inswinging yorker from Natarajan. You can't take risks against this ball from Natarajan. Jammed back to him
shortish and angling into middle, Mitchell camps back and works it to midwicket
very full and on the stumps, driven back to Natarajan who makes a partial stop and slows it down
wide on the crease once again, but tighter line from Natarajan. Hard length and outside off, glided to point with soft hands
wide on the crease, but the line is wrong from Natarajan. Short and drifting down the leg side, helped away past short fine leg for four more
mighty full and on off, driven back to the bowler
back of a length and slanting into the top of off, drop and run to point
overpitched and outside off, Gaikwad leans into it and crunnnnnnches it to the right of the off-side sweeper
tapped past point. On a length and attached with width outside off, Gaikwad leans back and puts it past the right of point
short and into the pads, possibly another slowie, nudged away through midwicket
That's Daz Mitchell's go-to shot: hitting down the ground with a high elbow. Knuckle ball, fullish and on middle, Mitchell holds his shape for long enough and pumps it over mid-on
back of a length and slanting into the top of off, dinked away between point and cover
floated up on middle, driven down the ground, but there's long-off to cut it off to a single
laced away through the covers. Gaikwad backs away outside leg once again and lets his hands flow through the shot
cracked away between point and cover. Fractionally short and outside off, Gaikwad manufactures more swinging room for himself and chops it hard into the ground
pushed through flat and quick outside off, tip and run to cover. Mitchell gets off the mark
backs away once again and drives between cover-point and extra-cover
backs away and stabs it back to the bowler
on-pace back-of-a-length delivery, skidding into off stump, inside-edged onto the pad

pumped to Shahbaz at wide long-on. Chepauk goes silent now. On a length and outside off, Rahane swings once again, but I suspect this was the slower ball from Bhuvneshwar. Rahane ends up dragging it to one of the two men at the boundary in the powerplay. So, Bhuvneshwar snags Rahane once again
another slowie. Short and Bhuvneshwar hides it away from Rahane's swinging arc. Stabbed out to extra-cover
fullish and on off, slower delivery from Bhuvneshwar. Gaikwad delays his push and dabs a single into the covers
on a good length and outside off, driven on the up to the left of short cover by Rahane
swung away over square leg. More attacking intent from CSK. He shimmies out to Bhuvneshwar, uses his wrists and launches the ball over square leg. Long leg can't stop it

okay, some attacking intent from a CSK opener. Short and outside off, but not short enough to pose a threat to Gaikwad. He takes this hip-high delivery from outside off and pulls it firmly over midwicket
back of a length and on the hips, not much attacking intent from Rahane, he can only deflect the ball away through the square-leg region

short and veering down the leg side. Wide called but there's a noise there. Klassen collects the ball and SRH think they have their man. Not given out caught behind on the field. Cummins and SRH challenge the on-field not-out decision. Rahane shapes to pull and the ball passes close to the bat. Might have just brushed the jersey on the way to Klaasen. Yes. No bat, though. No wide
good length and slanting into middle and leg, Gaikwad whisks a single down to mid-on
nice and full, moves back in at off stump, Rahane jams an inside edge onto his pad and manages to get across to the other end
good length and sliding in at off and middle, Gaikwad dabs another single to point
starts off with a leg-side wide as he searches for inswing
back of a length and largely holds its line outside off, Gaikwad glides a single to point. Good first over from Bhuvneshwar
shorter and on the hips, diverted away to the right of Shahbaz at midwicket
much shorter and angling in at the top of off, punchily defended down to mid-off by Rahane
some outswing from Bhuvneshwar! Much fuller, angling in, then nipping away past the outside edge as Rahane drives loosely and misses
back of a length and slanting in at the top of off, it's that in-between length, as Rahane blocks from the crease
good length and slanting into middle and leg, Rahane uses his wrists and finds a double to the right of midwicket

Spanked straight to Moeen Ali and that's a massive win wrapped up for CSK! Full outside off, Unadkat looks to slap it away on the off side but hits it right at the fielder. Good low catch by Moeen Ali
Back of length on leg, Bhuvneshwar fends with an open face to run it down to deep third
Full outside off and angling in, Unadkat pings it out through point to get off the mark
Catch no. 5 for Daryl Mitchell! Full and angling into Shahbaz, who looks to play a pick-up shot over square leg. But like so many before him today, he just doesn't hit it long enough
Back of length delivery around off, Shahbaz ramps it and it just clears Chahar at short third
Clipped away to deep backward square. A bit of a mix-up between the two fielders there and they get two
Full and wide, squeezed to point
Helps a length ball through square leg for a single

Another catch for Mitchell! Fourth in the match! Full outside off, not quite in the slot, but Cummins goes downtown. Doesn't get all of it and that's gone straight the Daz, who has been safe as a house all evening long

Bouncer outside off, Cummins waits on it before seeing it go past him. Well, he thinks it's gone over him as well and reviews for a wide. Cummins was crouching just a bit and the ball just about went above his helmet so the third umpire decides it's a fair delivery and SRH lose both reviews
Back of length outside off, pace off, Cummins tries to cut and misses
Shardul goes wide again, Cummins squeezes it out to deep backward point

Full and wide, Cummins takes a step across but pulls out of the shot. The ball did go outside the tramline but it's not given wide. Maybe because Cummins had moved towards the off side. Cummins reviews the decision, but in vain.
Hammered over point! Fuller length this time, and outside off. Cummins thrashes an aerial drive square on the off side
Gets beaten first ball. It's a length ball outside off that just seams away ever so slightly as Cummins looks to steer it fine on the off side with an open bat face

Samad picks out long-off and Shardul gets a wicket. Good catch by Rizvi in the deep. Cross-seam length ball outside off. Samad free his arms and swings through the line but ends up slicing it a little and not getting the elevation he needed. Rizvi settles under it and takes it low
Angles a length ball into him, Shahbaz works it away towards wide long-on
Full around off, eased to cover for a quick single

Klaasen holes out. End of his struggles today. Pathirana went for the yorker, but it turned into a low full toss on middle and off. Klaasen goes downtown, but can't get under it enough. Simple catch at long-on and CSK will feel much more relaxed now that the danger man is back in the hut
Dug in short and wide, Samad waits on it before dabbing it to deep third
Fuller in length, outside off, he looks to cut but can only get an inside edge onto the ground
Creamed over long-on! Length ball outside off sits up nicely and Samad swings through the line. Great power
127kph length ball just outside off, Klaasen looks to pull it away but gets an inside edge past Dhoni on the off side
Very wide yorker, Samad reaches out but can only get an inside edge onto the ground en route to Dhoni
Wide yorker, Klaasen looks to drive and inside edges it onto his pads. The ball deflects to the off side and they sneak a run
Short outside off, flat-batted to long-on for a single
Full and wide, Samad goes across the stumps and looks to heave it away but misses altogether
Short and wide, Klaasen goes across the stumps to fetch it from outside off and pull to deep midwicket
On a length, wide of off at 140kph, Klaasen reaches out for it but can't connect
Drives a full delivery to cover for a single. Jadeja bowls out with figures of 1 for 22!
Eased to deep point for a single
On a length outside off, slapped out to cover
Tossed up wide and Klaasen lets it go
On a length, cut hard to backward point and Moeen can't hold on so they steal a single
Samad chases after a length ball fired wide of off and hits it to point
Chops a short ball towards point

Did Dhoni drop that? Full outside off, and he pushes at it and gets an outside edge. It goes low to Dhoni's right and he dives at it. Think it just brushes his gloves before hitting the ground. Was a touch chance nonetheless
Length ball outside off, cut away to deep point
Short outside off, pulled away through midwicket for a single that takes SRH to 100
Straight to mid-off! Or wait, did that not carry? It's full outside off and he drills it flat towards Moeen Ali, but it bounces just short of him!
Back of length outside off, Samad stands tall and crunches it through cover

On a length, punched to the non-striker's right again. Jadeja runs across and tries to use his foot to stop it but ends up kicking it further away so he has to sprint now to retrieve it. But the batters don't risk a run
Length ball on off punched out to long-on
Full on leg, clipped out through midwicket
Klaasen finally enters the chat! This is very full on middle and leg, Klaasen just clears his front leg to make room and hammers it over long-off
On a length on off, he backs away and punches it to cover
On a length on leg, clipped out through square leg
Pathirana goes for a 147kph yorker again, but this time outside off. Samad pushes it out towards cover for a quick single to get off the mark
Yorked him! Middle stump is out of the ground and so is Markram! Inswinging yorker at 147kph and Markram swings across the line in vain. Brilliant delivery from the Sri Lankan!
Full toss fired down leg for another wide
Length ball on off, swung away to deep square leg
Goes for a leg stump yorker, Klaasen clips it out to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer goes down leg side so he will have to rebowl that
Flings it full outside off, Markram drives it out to long-on
Starts off with a length ball outside off. Klaasen underedges it onto the ground and it rolls behind and they steal a single

Back-of-length cutter pulled out towards deep midwicket and the batters sprint for two. Dhoni is sharp to deflect the throw at the striker's end onto the stumps in one motion, but the batter was in safely. Nifty work from him with the glove nonetheless
Full outside off, slapped to cover's left for a quick single
Slower bouncer on leg, pulled away through midwicket after fetching it from around off stump
129kph short ball on leg, pulled gently out to deep midwicket
On a length on off and going across him, Klaasen looks for the cut and underedges it onto the ground
Full on leg, Klaasen looks to fend and it goes to backward point off the outside half of the bat
Gets off the mark with a drive to deep cover

Huge roar as MS Dhoni settles under a skier! It's an absolute half-tracker as Jadeja digs it into the pitch, but it bounces more than you'd expect from a spinner. Nitish goes for a mighty heave and ends up top-edging it. Dhoni has to move to his left and take it, and he does just that
Tossed full around off, driven out to long-off
Markram backs away to make room and Jadeja tosses it a little wider. It spins away too as Markram misses his cut
Whips a length ball out to long-on
Speared full on off, he clips it to the bowler's right. They don't risk the single
On a length outside off, he runs it down to deep third's right
On a length outside off, he taps it through midwicket for two
Length ball with width on it and Markram cuts it away to deep cover
On a length outside off, cut to point

Markram is lucky that doesn't go all the way. Dug in short and Markram goes for a tennis forehand. The ball lobs up high but doesn't carry to long-on coming in. My bad, that was a free hit so even a catch wouldn't have mattered

That was a bit wild! No ball signalled immediately. Ball must have slipped out of his hand there! Fires a full toss at almost head-height and Markram has to dodge under that. He was attempting the knuckle ball
Inside edged past the keeper an short fine and Markram picks up a boundary. It's a length ball angling down leg and Markram swipes across the line but can only get a bottom edge
Length ball whipped away through midwicket for a single
Dropped short on off, he rocks back and cuts it but can't get it past short third
Tucked to deep midwicket
Driven straight of the sweeper cover, but he does well to run across and stop the boundary. This was a length ball outside off and Nitish slapped it away hard
Darted full on middle, Markram drives it out to long-off
Full outside off, driven out to the off side sweeper
ON a length on leg, Nitish can only defend. And SRH end up on 53 for 3 after the powerplay
Full ball on leg holds up before seaming away. Reddy fends at it and the ball pings off the bat towards cover
Full delivery tucked away straight of deep midwicket
Wide yorker, and he gets his bat down to squeeze it square on the off side for a quick single
On a length on middle, punched to cover
Fired full outside off, Markram reaches out and drives with an open face and it runs away behind point. Jadeja at deep point can't get across
On a length, on a fifth-stump line. Nitish Reddy wants to punch it away but it's too close to his body and he can only parry it back towards the bowler. Good over from Chahar, just three off it
Short and wide, he goes for the cut but can't connect
Full outside off, lobbed over the bowler's head towards mid-off
Short ball angled into Nitish, who miscues his pull. It falls safely around the midwicket area
On a length outside off, cut away along the ground to deep point
Full outside off, Markram drives to cover
On a length outside off, Nitish Kumar Reddy punches it out to deep point's right and they are quick to run two

Abhishek perishes like Head did! Short ball angled across him and he stands tall and cuts it in the air but straight to Daryl Mitchell at deep point! Tushar Deshpande has come in like a wrecking ball against this SRH lineup!
Smashed down the ground! On a length on off, Abhishek frees his arms as the ball goes across him and flat-bats it straight back past the non-striker
Back of length delivery just outside off, Markram awkwardly punches it to mid-off
Length ball going across Abhishek, who slaps it to the cover point fielder
Fends a length ball towards mid-off to prevent the hat-trick
Tucks a length ball off his hips to backward square leg
Digs in a slower ball on middle and leg, Abhishek waits on it before helping it fine on the leg side
On a length outside off and angling into Markram, who tucks it square on the leg side
Slashed over short third! Length ball going across him and he frees his arms and goes for the cut. It goes finer than he would have liked but he gets the boundary
And he gets off the mark with a lovely boundary. Full length outside off, shaping away, and Markram stands tall and opens the face to drive it to point's left
On a length on middle, he works it through midwicket for a single

Two in two! Full on middle, 134/5kph, Anmolpreet looks to turn it leg side and is early into the shot. Gets a leading edge that pops up on the off side. Moeen Ali backtracks from mid-off and grabs it. There was a hint of away swing there that did Anmolpreet in

Sliced to deep point! The slower ball does the trick. Deshpande goes full and fires it across Head, who looks to loft it on the off side. Doesn't get a hold of it and Daryl Mitchell settles under it for the catch
Length ball on off, Abhishek taps it towards point for a single
Have some of that! Slot ball around middle and off and Abhishek boshes it over deep midwicket and into a sea of yellow
Length ball on off and going across him, Head slaps it out to deep point
Flicked nonchalantly over deep square leg! First six of the chase. This is full around leg and that's bread and butter for the Aussie opener. Picks it up off his pads and deposits it in the stands
Full length delivery around off and leaving Head, who shoulders arms and lets it pass. Not a bad first over from Deepak Chahar
Length ball on off, parried behind square on the leg side off the inside half of the bat and they get a single
Chahar goes full, and gets it to swing into Abhishek. Pitches full on middle and Abhishek leans forward and flicks it out to deep midwicket
Back of length delivery angled into Head, who jabs it away to deep midwicket
On a length closer to off, cramping him for room. Head punches it out to cover
And Travis Head is away! Back of length delivery on middle and angling across Head, who frees his arms and thrashes it through the covers on the back foot
